title.ar: الشروط If / Elif / Else و match-case في بايثون

description.en: Use Python's indentation-based conditions, truthiness checks, ternary expressions, and structural pattern matching.
description.ar: استخدم الشروط القائمة على المسافات البادئة وفحوصات الصدق والتعبيرات الثلاثية والمطابقة الهيكلية match-case.

snippets.code:
score = 87

# if / elif / else — indentation defines the blocks
if score >= 90:
    print("Excellent")
elif score >= 75:
    print("Good")
else:
    print("Needs improvement")

# Ternary (conditional expression)
status = "Pass" if score >= 50 else "Fail"

# Truthiness and membership
items = []
if not items:
    print("Empty list")

role = "admin"
if role in {"admin", "owner"}:
    print("Elevated access")

# Chained comparisons
if 0 <= score <= 100:
    print("Valid score")

# Structural pattern matching (Python 3.10+)
command = ("move", 10, 20)
match command:
    case ("move", x, y):
        print(f"Moving to {x},{y}")
    case ("quit",):
        print("Bye")
    case {"action": action}:
        print(f"Dict action: {action}")
    case _:
        print("Unknown command")

print(status)

title.ar: عمليات القواميس والدمج

description.en: Use get, setdefault, defaultdict, and the merge operator to manage dictionaries safely and idiomatically.

snippets.code:
from collections import defaultdict

inventory = {"apple": 12, "banana": 5}

# Safe access with a default
print(inventory.get("cherry", 0))

# Insert only when absent
inventory.setdefault("cherry", 0)
inventory["cherry"] += 7

# Merge with the union operator (Python 3.9+)
restock = {"banana": 20, "mango": 3}
merged = inventory | restock
print(merged)

# Group values by key
sales = [("fruit", 10), ("veg", 4), ("fruit", 6), ("veg", 9)]
grouped = defaultdict(int)
for category, amount in sales:
    grouped[category] += amount

for category, total in grouped.items():
    print(f"{category}: {total}")

# Iterate deterministically
for name in sorted(merged):
    print(name, merged[name])

title.ar: قراءة الملفات بأمان باستخدام pathlib

description.en: Read text and JSON files using context managers, handle missing files, and stream large files line by line.

snippets.code:
import json
from pathlib import Path

path = Path("data/config.json")

# Read the entire file as text
try:
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    print(text)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(f"Missing file: {path}")

# Parse JSON
if path.exists():
    config = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    print(config.get("name", "unnamed"))

# Stream a large file line by line
with open("data/log.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
    for line_number, line in enumerate(handle, start=1):
        if "ERROR" in line:
            print(f"{line_number}: {line.rstrip()}")

# Write files atomically-ish
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(json.dumps({"name": "app"}, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")

<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

// Variables start with $
$name = 'Ali';
$age = 25;
$height = 1.78;
$isDeveloper = true;
$tags = ['php', 'web'];          // indexed array
$user = ['city' => 'Amman'];     // associative array

// Constants
define('SITE_NAME', 'SyntaxHub');
const VERSION = '1.0';

// Double quotes interpolate, single quotes do not
echo "Name: $name, Age: $age\n";
echo 'No interpolation: $name' . PHP_EOL;

// printf-style formatting
printf("Height: %.2f m | City: %s | Site: %s%n", $height, $user['city'], SITE_NAME);

// Type inspection
echo gettype($height) . PHP_EOL;         // double
var_dump($tags);                         // structured output
print_r($user);                          // readable output

// Safe conversion
$number = filter_var('42', FILTER_VALIDATE_INT);
echo 'Parsed: ' . ($number * 2) . PHP_EOL;

echo 'Tier: ' . (VERSION >= '1.0' ? 'stable' : 'beta') . PHP_EOL;

title.ar: الشروط If / Else و Switch و match في PHP

description.en: Branch with if/else, the null-coalescing operator, classic switch, and the strict match expression (PHP 8).
description.ar: استخدم الشروط if/else ومعامل التجميع الفارغ وswitch التقليدي وتعبير match الصارم (PHP 8).

snippets.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

$score = 87;

// if / else if / else
if ($score >= 90) {
    echo "Excellent\n";
} elseif ($score >= 75) {
    echo "Good\n";
} else {
    echo "Needs improvement\n";
}

// Ternary and null coalescing
$status = $score >= 50 ? 'Pass' : 'Fail';
$username = null;
$display = $username ?? 'Guest';

// Alternative syntax works well in templates
if ($score > 0):
    echo "Score recorded\n";
endif;

// switch with break
switch (true) {
    case $score >= 90:
        $grade = 'A';
        break;
    case $score >= 80:
        $grade = 'B';
        break;
    default:
        $grade = 'C';
}

// match is an expression and compares strictly (PHP 8+)
$message = match ($grade) {
    'A' => 'Outstanding work!',
    'B' => 'Well done!',
    default => 'Keep practising.',
};

echo "$status — Grade $grade: $message, user $display\n";

title.ar: الحلقات في PHP: For و While و foreach

description.en: Iterate with for, while, do-while and foreach, including key=>value pairs in associative arrays.
description.ar: كرّر عبر for و while و do-while و foreach بما يشمل أزواج مفتاح=>قيمة في المصفوفات الترابطية.

snippets.code:
<?php

// for loop
for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
    if ($i === 2) {
        continue;
    }
    echo $i . ' ';
}
echo PHP_EOL;

// while loop
$countdown = 3;
while ($countdown > 0) {
    echo "T-minus $countdown\n";
    $countdown--;
}

// do-while runs at least once
$attempts = 0;
do {
    $attempts++;
    echo "Attempt $attempts\n";
} while ($attempts < 2);

// foreach over indexed arrays
$languages = ['PHP', 'C#', 'SQL'];
foreach ($languages as $language) {
    echo strtoupper($language) . PHP_EOL;
}

// foreach with index
foreach ($languages as $index => $language) {
    echo ($index + 1) . ". $language\n";
}

// foreach over associative arrays (key => value)
$prices = ['Keyboard' => 49.99, 'Monitor' => 199.00];
foreach ($prices as $product => $price) {
    printf("%s: $%.2f%n", $product, $price);
}

title.ar: دوال PHP: الأنواع والقيم الافتراضية والدوال المغلقة

description.en: Declare functions with type hints and return types, default and variadic parameters, closures with use, and arrow functions.
description.ar: صرّح بدوال مع تلميحات الأنواع وأنواع الإرجاع والمعاملات الافتراضية والمتغيرة، والدوال المغلقة بـ use، والدوال السهمية.

snippets.code:
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

// Typed parameters and return type
function add(int $a, int $b): int
{
    return $a + $b;
}

// Default and nullable parameters
function greet(string $name, string $greeting = 'Hello'): string
{
    return "$greeting, $name!";
}

// Variadic parameters
function sum(float ...$numbers): float
{
    return array_sum($numbers);
}

// Multiple return values via an array
function minMax(array $values): array
{
    return ['min' => min($values), 'max' => max($values)];
}

// Closure capturing outer scope with use
$taxRate = 0.16;
$withTax = function (float $price) use ($taxRate): float {
    return $price * (1 + $taxRate);
};

// Arrow function (auto-captures by value)
$square = fn (int $n): int => $n * $n;

// Null return type and nullsafe call
function findUser(int $id): ?string
{
    return $id > 0 ? "User #$id" : null;
}

echo add(2, 3) . PHP_EOL;
echo greet('Sara', greeting: 'Welcome') . PHP_EOL;   // named arguments
echo sum(1.5, 2.5, 3.0) . PHP_EOL;

['min' => $min, 'max' => $max] = minMax([4, 9, 1, 12]);
echo "Range: $min – $max\n";

echo 'With tax: ' . number_format($withTax(100), 2) . PHP_EOL;
echo 'Square: ' . $square(9) . PHP_EOL;
echo findUser(7) ?? 'No user found';

title.en: Secure PDO Queries with Prepared Statements
title.ar: استعلامات PDO آمنة مع العبارات المُحضّرة

description.en: Connect to MySQL using PDO, run parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection, and fetch results as associative arrays.
description.ar: اتصل بـ MySQL باستخدام PDO، ونفّذ استعلامات بمعاملات لمنع حقن SQL، واجلب النتائج كمصفوفات ترابطية.

snippets.code:
<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

$dsn = 'mysql:host=localhost;dbname=shop;charset=utf8mb4';
$options = [
    PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE            => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
    PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC,
    PDO::ATTR_EMULATE_PREPARES   => false,
];

try {
    $pdo = new PDO($dsn, 'root', '', $options);

    $statement = $pdo->prepare(
        'SELECT id, name, price FROM products WHERE category = :category AND price < :max'
    );
    $statement->execute(['category' => 'books', 'max' => 50]);

    foreach ($statement->fetchAll() as $product) {
        printf("#%d %s - $%.2f\n", $product['id'], $product['name'], $product['price']);
    }
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    error_log($e->getMessage());
    http_response_code(500);
    echo 'Database error.';
}

title.en: SQL Core Syntax: SELECT, Literals & Casting
title.ar: أساسيات SQL: SELECT والقيم الحرفية والتحويل

description.en: Select columns and expressions, alias results, concatenate strings, cast types, and handle NULL values.
description.ar: اختر الأعمدة والتعبيرات، وأعطِ أسماء مستعارة للنتائج، وادمج النصوص، وحوّل الأنواع، وتعامل مع قيم NULL.

snippets.code:
-- Select specific columns with aliases
SELECT
    id,
    first_name AS name,
    email
FROM users;

-- Expressions, concatenation and casting
SELECT
    id,
    first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name,   -- PostgreSQL / SQLite
    price,
    price * 1.16                    AS price_with_tax,
    CAST(price AS INTEGER)          AS price_rounded,
    UPPER(category)                 AS category_upper
FROM products
WHERE price > 10
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- String and date functions
SELECT
    CONCAT(first_name, ' ', last_name)        AS full_name,   -- MySQL
    COALESCE(phone, 'Not provided')           AS phone,
    CURRENT_DATE                              AS today,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at)             AS joined_year
FROM users;

-- NULL-safe filtering
SELECT id, email
FROM users
WHERE phone IS NOT NULL
  AND deleted_at IS NULL;

-- Distinct values
SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products ORDER BY category;

title.ar: المنطق الشرطي في SQL: CASE و IF

description.en: Branch inside queries with searched and simple CASE, NULLIF, and conditional aggregation for totals.
description.ar: تفرّع داخل الاستعلامات باستخدام CASE البحثي والبسيط و NULLIF والتجميع الشرطي لحساب المجاميع.

snippets.code:
-- Simple CASE on a column
SELECT
    id,
    status,
    CASE status
        WHEN 'paid'    THEN 'Complete'
        WHEN 'pending' THEN 'Awaiting payment'
        ELSE 'Cancelled'
    END AS status_label
FROM orders;

-- Searched CASE (range conditions)
SELECT
    name,
    price,
    CASE
        WHEN price >= 500 THEN 'Premium'
        WHEN price >= 100 THEN 'Standard'
        ELSE 'Budget'
    END AS tier
FROM products;

-- Conditional aggregation: one total per status
SELECT
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*)                                        AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN total ELSE 0 END) AS revenue
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id;

-- Avoid division by zero with NULLIF
SELECT AVG(total / NULLIF(quantity, 0)) AS avg_unit_price
FROM order_items;

title.en: Iteration in SQL: Generators, Recursion & Cursors
title.ar: التكرار في SQL: المولّدات والتكرار الذاتي والمؤشرات

description.en: SQL is set-based, so loops are expressed differently: series generators, recursive CTEs, window frames, and a comparison with procedural loops (PL/pgSQL).
description.ar: SQL مبني على المجموعات، لذا يُعبّر عن التكرار بطرق مختلفة: مولّدات السلاسل و CTE التكرارية وإطارات النوافذ، ومقارنة بحلقات الإجرائية (PL/pgSQL).

snippets.code:
-- 1) Generate a sequence instead of looping (PostgreSQL)
SELECT generate_series(1, 5) AS n, generate_series(1, 5) * n_sq AS square
FROM generate_series(1, 5) AS n_sq;

-- MySQL equivalent of a simple counter
WITH RECURSIVE numbers AS (
    SELECT 1 AS n
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM numbers WHERE n < 5
)
SELECT n, n * n AS square FROM numbers;

-- 2) Recursive CTE: walk an employee hierarchy
WITH RECURSIVE org AS (
    SELECT id, name, manager_id, 1 AS level
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IS NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.id, e.name, e.manager_id, o.level + 1
    FROM employees e
    JOIN org o ON e.manager_id = o.id
)
SELECT level, name FROM org ORDER BY level, name;

-- 3) Iterate rows with a window frame
SELECT
    sale_date,
    amount,
    SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY sale_date) AS running_total
FROM sales;

-- 4) Procedural loop (PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL)
DO $$
BEGIN
    FOR counter IN 1..3 LOOP
        RAISE NOTICE 'Iteration %', counter;
    END LOOP;
END $$;

-- And a plain cursor loop when row-by-row logic is unavoidable
-- DECLARE cur CURSOR FOR SELECT id FROM orders; LOOP FETCH cur INTO v_id; EXIT WHEN NOT FOUND; ... END LOOP;

title.ar: دوال SQL: التجميعية والمعرّفة من المستخدم

description.en: Use built-in aggregate and scalar functions, then create reusable user-defined functions with CREATE FUNCTION.
description.ar: استخدم الدوال التجميعية والقياسية المدمجة، ثم أنشئ دوالًا قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام عبر CREATE FUNCTION.

snippets.code:
-- Built-in aggregates with parameters
SELECT
    COUNT(*)                     AS total_orders,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)  AS unique_customers,
    SUM(total)                   AS revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(total), 2)         AS average_order,
    MIN(total)                   AS smallest,
    MAX(total)                   AS largest
FROM orders
WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01';

-- Scalar functions
SELECT
    UPPER(email)                          AS email_upper,
    LENGTH(first_name)                    AS name_length,
    COALESCE(phone, 'Not provided')       AS phone,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at)       AS signup_month,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM created_at)          AS signup_day
FROM users;

-- String aggregation per group
SELECT
    category,
    STRING_AGG(name, ', ' ORDER BY name) AS products
FROM products
GROUP BY category;

-- User-defined function (PostgreSQL)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION order_total_with_tax(p_order_id INT, p_rate NUMERIC DEFAULT 0.16)
RETURNS NUMERIC
LANGUAGE sql
STABLE
AS $$
    SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price) * (1 + p_rate), 2)
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id = p_order_id;
$$;

SELECT order_total_with_tax(42)            AS full_price,
       order_total_with_tax(42, 0.05)      AS discounted;

title.ar: INNER JOIN مع الأسماء المستعارة

description.en: Combine rows from customers and orders, filter by date range, and sort by total spend.
description.ar: اجمع الصفوف من جدولي العملاء والطلبات، وصفِّ حسب نطاق زمني، ورتّب حسب إجمالي الإنفاق.

snippets.code:
SELECT
    c.id            AS customer_id,
    c.full_name,
    c.email,
    COUNT(o.id)     AS order_count,
    SUM(o.total)    AS total_spent
FROM customers AS c
INNER JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.created_at >= '2026-01-01'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.id, c.full_name, c.email
HAVING SUM(o.total) > 100
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 20;

title.ar: تحليلات GROUP BY و HAVING

description.en: Aggregate sales per category and month, then keep only categories that exceed a revenue threshold.
description.ar: جمّع المبيعات حسب الفئة والشهر، ثم أبقِ فقط الفئات التي تتجاوز حد الإيرادات المطلوب.

snippets.code:
SELECT
    p.category,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', s.sold_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*)                        AS units_sold,
    SUM(s.quantity * p.price)       AS revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(s.quantity), 2)       AS avg_quantity
FROM sales AS s
JOIN products AS p ON p.id = s.product_id
WHERE s.sold_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months'
GROUP BY p.category, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.sold_at)
HAVING SUM(s.quantity * p.price) >= 5000
ORDER BY month DESC, revenue DESC;

title.ar: الفهارس المركبة وخطط الاستعلام

description.en: Create a covering composite index and inspect the execution plan to confirm index usage.
description.ar: أنشئ فهرسًا مركبًا مغطيًا وافحص خطة التنفيذ للتأكد من استخدامه.

snippets.code:
-- Composite index matching the WHERE + ORDER BY pattern
CREATE INDEX idx_orders_customer_status_date
    ON orders (customer_id, status, created_at DESC)
    INCLUDE (total);

-- Covering index for the dashboard summary
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_email_lower
    ON users (LOWER(email));

-- Verify usage
EXPLAIN ANALYZE
SELECT customer_id, created_at, total
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id = 42
  AND status = 'completed'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 10;

-- Remove an unused index safely
DROP INDEX IF EXISTS idx_orders_created_at;
